subject: Request: Temporary on-call augmentation + SLO granularity for Northwind
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@northwind.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+platform@northwind.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: recurring overnight P1s — request for temporary on-call augmentation

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for taking my call earlier. Over the last 3 weeks we've had 4 high-priority incidents during our Pacific overnight window (00:30–05:15 PST) that hit our customers and required manual routing. The incidents are resolved quickly but the first-response time is inconsistent because our current on-call is stretched thin across regions.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a temporary on-call augmentation (extra dedicated pager or shadow) for the overnight window for ~3 weeks while we stabilize?
- We'd like to pilot more granular SLOs for response: separate "emergency/P1a" (system-wide outage; 15 min ack) vs "critical/P1b" (single-customer outage; 45 min ack). That would help us set expectations for escalation.

We also need clarity on the escalation ladder during this pilot (who to call after the first 15 min, and any exec contact for SLA credit decisions).

I've attached a short incident-log-summary.pdf that shows timestamps and impact for the four events.

Can you share a proposal and any operational constraints we should expect? Procurement will need a one-off amendment if we change SLO windows.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Reliability
Northwind Logistics

[attachment: incident-log-summary.pdf]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@northwind.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: recurring overnight P1s — request for temporary on-call augmentation

Samantha —

Appreciate the detail and the incident timeline. We're sympathetic to the pain overnight; happy to support a short pilot. High level proposal below; I attached a more formal draft plan (redwood-temp-augmentation-plan.docx).

Proposal (pilot, 3 weeks):
- Coverage: add a dedicated overnight shadow pager for Northwind for 00:00–06:00 PST (covers your 00:30–05:15 peak). Shadow is fully trained on the Northwind runbook and will act as primary ack/triage for P1/P2 during the window.
- SLO granularity: pilot P1a (15 min ack), P1b (45 min ack). P2 unchanged (4 hour response). We'll instrument SLI tags so metrics are reported per-class.
- Escalation ladder (pilot):
  1) On-call (shadow) — immediate ack/triage
  2) Primary on-call (regional) — within 30 min if unacknowledged
  3) Ben Carter (Support Ops Lead) — 60 min
  4) Laura Bennett (EMEA/US ops director) — 90 min / exec contact for SLA credit decisions
- Credits / amendment: if you accept SLO window changes we will issue a one-off SLO amendment for the pilot period. Procurement/Legal sign-off required.
- Timeline: kick-off within 72 hours of sign-off; 3-week pilot; daily morning sync for first 5 days, then alternate-day check-ins.

Open items:
- Is Northwind comfortable with the 00:00–06:00 PST shadow window?
- We will need an updated procurement contact for the DocuSign amendment.
- Ben — we will need a quick runbook sync and confirmation you can staff the shadow.

If that looks good I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for tomorrow afternoon and loop in procurement.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
email: evelyn_hart@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0210

[attachment: redwood-temp-augmentation-plan.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@northwind.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jul 2025 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: recurring overnight P1s — request for temporary on-call augmentation

Folks — happy to take point on the runbook work and staffing. Quick notes:

- Runbook changes: I'll prepare a compact "overnight triage" appendix that identifies immediate remediation steps, clear escalation triggers (P1a vs P1b), and contact numbers. I'll attach a runbook diff once done.
- Staffing: I can assign one experienced shadow from our US-North team for the pilot window. They'll be dedicated to Northwind for the 00:00–06:00 PST block and will not be on other rotations during that block.
- Capacity/throughput: if we expect sustained traffic spikes overnight (inference load), we should consider temporarily pinning a Dedicated capacity pool for the pilot nights to avoid throttling. That would be a small incremental cost — I can put rough estimates together.

Ben
Ben Carter
Support & Escalations Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0142

Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: recurring overnight P1s — request for temporary on-call augmentation

Evelyn / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. The proposed window (00:00–06:00 PST) works for us. Procurement is requesting two things before formal sign-off:
1) Exact SLO language for the amendment (we need the wording to match our internal SLAs).
2) A DocuSign packet for the one-off amendment + a PO reference.

Also: can you confirm the response commitment in plain terms? Example: P1a = Redwood will acknowledge within 15 minutes; if not acknowledged within 30 minutes, escalate to Ben; if not resolved within 4 hours, we trigger a management bridge.

Procurement contact: Maria Torres <maria.torres@northwind.com> — I'll ask her to expect your DocuSign.

If you can send the amendment draft + DocuSign link today we can sign and kick off tomorrow.

Samantha

Subject: Re: recurring overnight P1s — request for temporary on-call augmentation — confirmed next steps

Samantha / Maria / team —

Thanks for the quick confirmation. Per action items discussed, here are the agreed next steps and timeline. Please reply if any item needs adjustment.

1) DocuSign amendment + PO
   - Laura will create the one-off SLO amendment wording (exact phrasing for P1a/P1b) and open a DocuSign packet today against deal NW-EXP-2025-09.
   - Laura to copy Procurement (Maria Torres) on the packet.
2) Pilot staffing & runbook
   - Ben to assign the overnight shadow (starts night of 2025-07-13) and deliver the runbook appendix by 2025-07-12 17:00 PST.
3) Technical safeguards
   - If the pilot sees repeated throughput risk, we will temporarily pin Dedicated capacity for overnight windows — Ben will provide cost estimate by 2025-07-11 EOD.
4) Monitoring / reporting
   - We'll emit P1a/P1b SLIs into your metrics dashboard and share daily morning digests for the first 5 days.
5) Escalation ladder (final language)
   - P1a: ack <= 15 min; if not acknowledged <= 30 min escalate to Ben; management bridge if open > 4 hours.
   - P1b: ack <= 45 min; escalate to primary on-call if not acknowledged <= 60 min.

Closing note: this is a temporary pilot (3 weeks) to stabilize overnight behavior. If the pilot reduces incidents, we'll propose a longer-term plan (possible dedicated standby capacity + contract amendment).

Ben, Laura, please confirm once runbook + DocuSign packet are posted and I'll schedule the kickoff (15–30 min) for Monday 2025-07-13 08:30 PST.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
